title: Stage view bug fixes: wheel-zoom pan reset, ruler offset, stroke-none
description: Bundle of verified stage/chrome bugs: (1) Wheel zoom resets vertical pan — onPanChange(newPanX, 0) hardcodes y=0 (StageArea.tsx:570-590); Shell stores panY=0 and the sync effect clobbers the correct internal value, so the stage jumps vertically on every wheel zoom while panned. Also onZoomChange/onPanChange are called INSIDE setState updater functions (StageArea.tsx:514-535 and zoom tool) — impure updaters double-fire under StrictMode; move them out. (2) Rulers assume the work area starts after the ruler but StageArea centers in the full container — constant 8px (rulerSize/2) error in tick labels and guide drops (Rulers.tsx:64,232-247,376-401). (3) Stroke None from the Color panel encodes as strokeColor #000000 + strokeAlpha 0, but shape creation ignores strokeAlpha (Shell.tsx:340-381) — no-stroke is impossible and strokes are always opaque; same issue in the ink-bottle handler (StageArea.tsx:658-665). See docs/01, docs/04.
